comments.quote: 春節三天，住在莫干山的山裡。 清晨是霧，午後是光，夜裡是滿山的靜。 白天在山裡走走，傍晚泡一池温泉，霧氣升起，人也慢了下來。 酒店不喧嘩，卻很有分寸：房間有温度，服務不打擾，細節都在。 真正讓人驚艷的，是節日裏還能過上這樣的慢日子。 人回城，心還在山裡。
comments.author: Jinzhanglaoye
comments.quoteEn: Three days over Spring Festival, up in the hills at Moganshan. Mist in the early morning, light in the afternoon, and at night the whole mountain quiet. Walks in the hills by day, a hot spring at dusk, the steam rising and everything slowing down. The hotel is not noisy but it judges things well: the rooms have warmth, the service does not intrude, the details are all there. What really struck us was having days this slow over a holiday. We went back to the city and left our heads on the mountain.
